Class BuiltinSchemaCatalog

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.schema.catalog.BuiltinSchemaCatalog
public final class BuiltinSchemaCatalog extends Object
Unified JSON Schema catalog. Core schemas (workflow, plugin-config) are registered inline. Node schemas are discovered at runtime via NodeProvider. Standalone schemas are discovered via SchemaProvider.
